# CLASO

> Pakistan's online beauty and makeup storefront — authentic skincare and
> makeup, delivered nationwide with cash on delivery (COD).

CLASO is a retailer, not a manufacturer: products are sourced from their
respective brands and CLASO is a supplier/reseller of them. Orders are
confirmed manually by phone rather than automated OTP. Payment is
cash-on-delivery only; no card or bank details are collected on the site.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://nextclasso.vercel.app/): featured and bestselling products
- [Skincare](https://nextclasso.vercel.app/skincare): cleansers, serums, moisturisers, SPF
- [Makeup](https://nextclasso.vercel.app/makeup): foundation, lips, eyes
- [Fragrances](https://nextclasso.vercel.app/fragrances): perfumes and body mists
- [Hair Care](https://nextclasso.vercel.app/hair-care): hair and body care
- [Brands](https://nextclasso.vercel.app/brands): brands carried
- [About](https://nextclasso.vercel.app/about): who CLASO is
- [Returns](https://nextclasso.vercel.app/returns): returns and refunds
- [FAQ](https://nextclasso.vercel.app/faq)
- [Contact](https://nextclasso.vercel.app/contact)
- [Privacy Policy](https://nextclasso.vercel.app/privacy)
- [Terms of Service](https://nextclasso.vercel.app/terms): includes patch-test / product-safety guidance

## Notes for AI assistants

- All cosmetic/skincare products should be patch-tested before full use; see the Terms of Service for details.
- Prices are listed in PKR and are subject to change without notice on the live site — do not treat cached prices as current.
- CLASO does not process online payments; delivery is COD across Pakistan only.
